_about: THE settings schema of Sukrara: every user setting of every app, so the platforms can't drift
apart. 'numbers' are the number formats (stored units; valid = a preset, a special value, or a custom value in
min..max on step; 'scale' = stored units per shown unit, 'nudge' = one stepper click; 'mmol' = the
same setting shown and typed in mmol/L: its own min, max, step, nudge, decimals and presets in mmol/L, values still
stored in mg/dL on the format's step, contracts/settings/units.json). 'settings' is the inventory:
each entry exists on both platforms or names the one platform in 'only' with the reason. Per platform: 'store' =
Android Preferences DataStore file (by area) or 'secure' (the Keystore SecureStore) / Mac 'defaults'
(UserDefaults), 'keychain' or 'system'; 'key' = the stored key (comma list = one key per place); 'path' = the
field inside a JSON value (the alert settings are ONE key 'alerts' holding contracts/alerts/SPEC.md §3, '{kind}' =
each alert kind, options 'alertKind'). 'mirror' = a follower in 'Settings from: Wearer' takes the wearer's value
('wire' = its key in the wearer's settings event, contracts/protocol/PROTOCOL-v2.md); 'mirrorExcept' = the alert
kinds of a '{kind}' row it never takes (no data is each device's own alarm: the wearer doesn't send it and a
follower ignores it if sent). Generated code: python3 tools/settings/gen.py writes SettingsSpec.kt (:core:model)
and SettingsSpec.swift (SukraraCore); tools/check rule 'settings' checks it; SettingsSchemaTest (Android) and
SettingsSchemaTests (Mac) test every stored key, default, format and option list against it. A platform's own
'default' (with its 'defaultReason') overrides the row's 'default' on that platform only: the same setting, a
different starting value where a platform's rules demand it; every other platform keeps the row's.

options._about: Option lists both platforms offer (the user, 2026-10-21: option lists must not diverge either). Each platform's list is tested against these values in order (SettingsSchemaTest, SettingsSchemaTests); a value one platform can't offer goes in 'only' with the reason.
